description:
AthleteOS is a personal development system for student athletes. It decides what training makes sense around your real sport schedule, teaches you why, and learns from a 45-second reflection each evening.

THREE THINGS, EVERY DAY
• Workout — what should I physically do today?
• Campus — what should I understand to become a smarter athlete?
• Reflection — what did I learn, and how should tomorrow adapt?

WORKOUTS THAT KNOW YOUR DAY
• After practice: 15–35 minutes of upper-body strength, trunk and injury prevention — no extra leg fatigue when practice already covered it
• Gym development days: 45–75 minutes in clear blocks — movement prep, power and speed, main strength, secondary strength, trunk and resilience, and conditioning when you need it
• The day before a game: a short primer. The day after: recovery
• Conditioning is programmed from what your sport already gives you: a cross-country runner gets no random extra running, a golfer gets real aerobic work
• "Why this plan?" on every workout: what practice already trained, what's avoided today, and why
• 60 sports with their formats and positions; 1,000+ exercises and drills with animated how-tos
• Apple Watch: live heart rate, rep counting and rest timers
• Off-season programs, tournament mode, and training together with a teammate

BUILT AROUND YOUR SCHEDULE
• A two-tap morning check-in, pre-filled from Apple Watch or any band that writes to Apple Health
• Connect your team or school calendar: games, practices and exams come in by themselves
• Sick, travelling, back after illness or a long school day: the plan adjusts

CAMPUS: LEARN SOMETHING USEFUL
• About 100 short lessons in nine areas and five levels: training science, anatomy and movement, nutrition, sleep and recovery, sports psychology, supplements (education, never advice), phones and attention, sport IQ and self-coaching
• Recommended for your day: a short night, a game tomorrow, a hard practice

REFLECTION
• Three to five quick questions in the evening. How it felt shapes tomorrow's plan — and sometimes you get one useful insight back

FOR COACHES AND ATHLETIC TRAINERS
• A free readiness board on iPhone, in iPad sideline mode, or on the web dashboard
• Return-to-play log, announcements, private notes and team workouts

SAFETY FIRST, PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Never a diagnosis. A head knock pauses training, and a doctor decides
• Fuel, don't diet: no calorie counting, no weight-loss goals
• Use it without an account. No ads, no tracking

ATHLETEOS PRO
Free: the check-in, your plan and every kind of workout, logging, the Apple Watch app, safety, three new lessons a day, sport guides, leagues and teams. Pro (monthly or yearly) adds the workout editor, unlimited lessons, full history and charts, the season calendar and more. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage them in your App Store account settings.

AthleteOS gives general training information for athletes 13 and up. It is not medical advice, never predicts injury, never clears anyone to return to play, and never replaces a coach, athletic trainer or doctor.

promotionalText: Training that knows your day — built around practice, games and how you feel, with the reason for every session. Plus 100 short lessons and a 45-second reflection.
